1
Nawazishon Ka Nazool Ho Ga.
Jahan Bhi Zikr-e-Batool Ho Ga.
Hai Jiss Pe Razi Rasool Zadi.
Ossi Pe Razi Rasool Ho Ga.
Darood Parh Kar Tu Dekh Oss Par.
Riza-e-Rab Ka Hasool Ho Ga.
Jo Iss Ke Dar Par Jhukaye Sar Ko.
Ossi Ka Sajda Qabool Ho Ga.
Hai Jiss Ko Hasil Dua-e-Zahra.
Na Roz-e-Mehshar Malol Ho Ga.
Jo Iss Ke Dushman Ka Hai Mokhalif.
Wo Admi Ba usool Ho Ga.
Nijat Oss Ka Naseeb Ho Gi.
Jo Janisar-e-Batool Ho Ga.
Addo-e-Zahra Hai Jo Bhi Sahil.
WO Shaks Be Had Fazool Ho Ga.
Manqabat::Makhdoma-e-Konain Hazrat Fatima:

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p = 'src/data/lyrics/nawazishon-ka-nazool-ho-ga-tajpoints-b5dcb478f024ff6d15aa.md'
old = subprocess.check_output(['git','show','HEAD:'+p], text=True).split('---')[2].strip().splitlines()
new = Path(p).read_text()
_, front, body = new.split('---')
roman = front.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1].splitlines()
source = body.strip().splitlines()
assert [s.strip().lower() for s in roman] == [s.rstrip('.').lower() for s in old[:-1]]
assert len(source) == len(roman) == 17 and source[0] == '۱'
assert '\\u200c' not in new
print('Verified 16 corresponding verses in stanza 1.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all 16 verses in Urdu script and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that both editions contain one stanza of 16 verses.

Set the Urdu title and RTL direction, retained the Roman alternate title, and removed `noUrdu`. I read “Addo-e-Zahra” as `عدوِ زہرا` and treated the trailing `Manqabat::` line as a dedication outside the verse. Only the selected lyric was edited.
